svg.title: 01 — Intelligence should compound.
svg.desc: Intelligence should compound. Build real ventures. Keep what their teams learn. Make the next one more capable. An owner-directed intelligence substrate for independent ventures. A measured signal travels from a source venture to another venture. The thesis is that the receiving venture should start more capable; that outcome is not yet measured. Thesis / product hypothesis
svg.text: Build ventures. Keep what teams learn.
Give the next one a stronger start.
